name: Flattened banana with coconut milk
summary: Chuối đập nước cốt dừa is flattened banana with coconut milk, eaten on the evening walk after the lake.
origin: The evening walk in town, on the provincial tourism site’s 48-hour day.
howToEat: Eat it on the walk after dinner. The site does not give how the banana is flattened or how much coconut milk goes on.
where: The evening walk after Hồ Trúc Giang. The provincial tourism site places a counter on Đại lộ Đồng Khởi, phường Phú Khương.
seoTitle: Flattened banana with coconut milk in Ben Tre
seoDescription: Chuối đập nước cốt dừa is flattened banana with coconut milk on the evening walk.
